title: Defaults to Dollars
description: A customer creates an invoice without specifying a currency at all. SwiftCargo should quietly default to USD rather than rejecting the request.
successCondition: Book a shipment, then POST /api/billing/shipments/:shipmentId/invoice with an empty JSON body ({}). The response is 201 with invoice.currency equal to "USD" and invoice.amountCents equal to the shipment's priceCents (USD to USD is a 1:1 conversion).
hints: docs/api/billing.md states the currency field defaults to USD when omitted — this isn't a validation error case.
Compare amountCents directly against the shipment's priceCents from the booking response to confirm the 1:1 default-currency conversion.
